name: @fuaran-ui/core-twins
description: Workspace-internal home of this host's twins of the Fuaran.Core reference subsystems: the DataFrame / Transform evaluator with list-parameter substitution and its canonical float layout, the capability runtime (invocationKey, validateArgs, registry), the function registry (findBySignature), and the op-stream actor encoding. Deliberately not published: each published package that re-exports a twin bundles it at build time, so no public import path depends on this package.
